name: The Fool
short_upright_meaning: An uncharted path invites a curious first step without requiring a perfect map.
short_reversed_meaning: Freedom becomes clearer when impulse is balanced with awareness of consequences.

hermetic.sephirothic_context: Bridges inner vision with daily action.

name: The Magician
short_upright_meaning: The tools are already on the table; focused intention can give them useful form.
short_reversed_meaning: Check whether attention and abilities are being spent on the work that matters.

hermetic.sephirothic_context: Bridges inner vision with daily action.

name: The High Priestess
short_upright_meaning: A quieter layer of understanding may emerge through observation rather than action.
short_reversed_meaning: Seek clarity between genuine inner knowing and guesses left unexamined.

hermetic.sephirothic_context: Bridges inner vision with daily action.

name: The Empress
short_upright_meaning: Care and patient cultivation can turn a small beginning into something alive.
short_reversed_meaning: Notice where constant tending leaves too little energy for the caretaker.

hermetic.sephirothic_context: Bridges inner vision with daily action.

name: The Emperor
short_upright_meaning: Clear boundaries and dependable structures can protect what is growing.
short_reversed_meaning: Consider whether control has displaced the purpose it was meant to serve.

hermetic.sephirothic_context: Bridges inner vision with daily action.

name: The Hierophant
short_upright_meaning: Inherited practices can be useful when their purpose is consciously understood.
short_reversed_meaning: Question rules that no longer fit, without dismissing everything they once taught.

hermetic.sephirothic_context: Bridges inner vision with daily action.

name: The Lovers
short_upright_meaning: An important choice asks whether your actions match your deeply held values.
short_reversed_meaning: Bring a divided priority into view before asking it to carry a commitment.

hermetic.sephirothic_context: Bridges inner vision with daily action.

name: The Chariot
short_upright_meaning: Energy from competing directions can become movement when guided deliberately.
short_reversed_meaning: Check whether the drive to advance is overruling the need to steer.

hermetic.sephirothic_context: Bridges inner vision with daily action.

name: Strength
short_upright_meaning: Steady courage often works better through gentleness than force.
short_reversed_meaning: Renew patience with your limits before treating fatigue as a failure of will.

hermetic.sephirothic_context: Bridges inner vision with daily action.

name: The Hermit
short_upright_meaning: Time apart from noise may help uncover what really deserves attention.
short_reversed_meaning: Solitude serves insight best when it does not become permanent retreat.

hermetic.sephirothic_context: Bridges inner vision with daily action.

name: Wheel of Fortune
short_upright_meaning: Conditions evolve; flexibility can uncover openings that rigid plans miss.
short_reversed_meaning: Accept what cannot be controlled while choosing a useful response.

hermetic.sephirothic_context: Bridges inner vision with daily action.

name: Justice
short_upright_meaning: Fair decisions begin with a clear-eyed look at evidence and consequences.
short_reversed_meaning: Revisit assumptions and take responsibility for the part you can change.

hermetic.sephirothic_context: Bridges inner vision with daily action.

name: The Hanged Man
short_upright_meaning: A pause can reveal a perspective that constant motion keeps hidden.
short_reversed_meaning: Distinguish purposeful waiting from staying stuck out of habit.

hermetic.sephirothic_context: Bridges inner vision with daily action.

name: Death
short_upright_meaning: An ending may make room for a different chapter; this is symbolic transformation, not literal death.
short_reversed_meaning: Notice what is being kept alive only because letting go feels unfamiliar.

hermetic.sephirothic_context: Bridges inner vision with daily action.

name: Temperance
short_upright_meaning: Combining different strengths thoughtfully can create more than either alone.
short_reversed_meaning: Find a workable rhythm between competing needs instead of swinging between extremes.

hermetic.sephirothic_context: Bridges inner vision with daily action.

name: The Devil
short_upright_meaning: Look at the habits or bargains that limit your freedom even when they feel familiar.
short_reversed_meaning: Recognizing a binding pattern can be the beginning of choosing differently.

hermetic.sephirothic_context: Bridges inner vision with daily action.

name: The Tower
short_upright_meaning: A challenged assumption can free you to construct a sounder foundation.
short_reversed_meaning: Rebuild deliberately instead of pretending nothing important shifted.

hermetic.sephirothic_context: Bridges inner vision with daily action.

name: The Star
short_upright_meaning: Quiet hope returns through restoration and a sense of meaningful possibility.
short_reversed_meaning: Small signs of renewal still matter when confidence has faded.

hermetic.sephirothic_context: Bridges inner vision with daily action.

name: The Moon
short_upright_meaning: Move carefully through uncertainty and distinguish intuition from untested fears.
short_reversed_meaning: A confusing story may become clearer as assumptions are checked.

hermetic.sephirothic_context: Bridges inner vision with daily action.

name: The Sun
short_upright_meaning: Warmth, openness and visible progress invite you to celebrate what is working.
short_reversed_meaning: Find an honest source of encouragement instead of demanding constant brightness.

hermetic.sephirothic_context: Bridges inner vision with daily action.

name: Judgement
short_upright_meaning: Looking back without denial can lead to a conscious new beginning.
short_reversed_meaning: Release endless self-judgment while remaining accountable to what you learned.

hermetic.sephirothic_context: Bridges inner vision with daily action.

name: The World
short_upright_meaning: A cycle comes together, revealing both what was achieved and what it makes possible.
short_reversed_meaning: An unfinished transition can still hold valuable progress.

hermetic.sephirothic_context: Bridges inner vision with daily action.

name: Ace of Wands
short_upright_meaning: An exciting idea offers energy for a first experiment, not yet a finished plan.
short_reversed_meaning: Protect the initial spark from pressure to prove itself too early.

name: 2 of Wands
short_upright_meaning: Consider the wider field before choosing which direction to explore.
short_reversed_meaning: A plan kept entirely in the imagination may need a modest real-world test.

name: 3 of Wands
short_upright_meaning: Early efforts begin reaching outward; watch what actually comes back.
short_reversed_meaning: Unexpected feedback may call for a revised route rather than abandonment.

name: 4 of Wands
short_upright_meaning: A shared milestone offers an opportunity to recognize support and belonging.
short_reversed_meaning: Notice whether the foundation needs care before the next gathering.

name: 5 of Wands
short_upright_meaning: Several strong energies collide; the challenge is turning disagreement into learning.
short_reversed_meaning: Unspoken tension or effort spent fighting the wrong battle may need attention.

name: 6 of Wands
short_upright_meaning: Acknowledge progress and share credit with those who helped.
short_reversed_meaning: Separate genuine achievement from the need for constant applause.

name: 7 of Wands
short_upright_meaning: Hold a meaningful boundary without treating every challenge as an enemy.
short_reversed_meaning: Ask which battles are worth the energy required to defend them.

name: 8 of Wands
short_upright_meaning: Several developments may align quickly; keep information flowing clearly.
short_reversed_meaning: Slowing the message can prevent speed from becoming confusion.

name: 9 of Wands
short_upright_meaning: Hard-won experience supports another effort, provided rest is not forgotten.
short_reversed_meaning: Distinguish wise caution from guarding against dangers that are no longer present.

name: 10 of Wands
short_upright_meaning: A meaningful commitment has become heavy; completion may require sharing the load.
short_reversed_meaning: Release burdens that were never yours to carry alone.

name: Page of Wands
short_upright_meaning: A playful experiment opens a path to learning through doing.
short_reversed_meaning: Give fresh enthusiasm enough direction to survive its first obstacle.

name: Knight of Wands
short_upright_meaning: Courage and movement can turn creative desire into experience.
short_reversed_meaning: Let enthusiasm lead without letting it skip every necessary check.

name: Queen of Wands
short_upright_meaning: Your presence and encouragement can make space for others to shine.
short_reversed_meaning: Protect the source of confidence rather than exhausting it for approval.

name: King of Wands
short_upright_meaning: A clear vision gains strength when it empowers others to contribute.
short_reversed_meaning: An ambitious plan needs listening as much as decisive direction.

name: Ace of Cups
short_upright_meaning: A fresh emotional opening invites care, creativity or connection.
short_reversed_meaning: Give feelings space without demanding that they immediately make sense.

name: 2 of Cups
short_upright_meaning: A meeting of equals becomes stronger through attentive exchange.
short_reversed_meaning: Repair communication where one side has stopped feeling heard.

name: 3 of Cups
short_upright_meaning: Community can turn a private joy into something shared.
short_reversed_meaning: Look for belonging without losing your own pace or boundaries.

name: 4 of Cups
short_upright_meaning: Not every offered possibility deserves an immediate yes; notice what really moves you.
short_reversed_meaning: A fresh look may reveal an opportunity hidden by dissatisfaction.

name: 5 of Cups
short_upright_meaning: A loss or disappointment deserves recognition alongside what remains available.
short_reversed_meaning: Healing may begin when attention can move beyond only what went wrong.

name: 6 of Cups
short_upright_meaning: A remembered kindness may illuminate a value worth carrying forward.
short_reversed_meaning: Honor the past without asking it to replace the present.

name: 7 of Cups
short_upright_meaning: Rich possibilities invite vision, but not every image will survive testing.
short_reversed_meaning: Choose one promising option to ground instead of chasing every imagined outcome.

name: 8 of Cups
short_upright_meaning: Leaving what no longer nourishes can be an act of self-respect.
short_reversed_meaning: Explore whether staying or returning is chosen freely or from fear.

name: 9 of Cups
short_upright_meaning: Recognize what already brings satisfaction before seeking the next milestone.
short_reversed_meaning: Ask whether external rewards are substituting for deeper contentment.

name: 10 of Cups
short_upright_meaning: A vision of harmony asks how people can feel safe and valued together.
short_reversed_meaning: Replace an idealized picture of happiness with honest connection.

name: Page of Cups
short_upright_meaning: A surprising feeling or creative idea deserves a tender hearing.
short_reversed_meaning: Bring an elusive feeling into words without forcing certainty.

name: Knight of Cups
short_upright_meaning: An invitation led by feeling is most helpful when paired with sincerity.
short_reversed_meaning: Check whether an attractive vision has enough practical grounding.

name: Queen of Cups
short_upright_meaning: Deep empathy is strongest when it includes protection of your own needs.
short_reversed_meaning: Care for others without becoming responsible for every feeling around you.

name: King of Cups
short_upright_meaning: Calm leadership comes from feeling deeply without being ruled by each wave.
short_reversed_meaning: Give difficult emotions honest room before presenting a composed exterior.

name: Ace of Swords
short_upright_meaning: A clear thought can cut through confusion and make a decision possible.
short_reversed_meaning: Check whether certainty arrived before the evidence did.

name: 2 of Swords
short_upright_meaning: Two competing considerations ask for an honest decision process.
short_reversed_meaning: Name the choice clearly rather than letting indecision decide for you.

name: 3 of Swords
short_upright_meaning: A painful truth can be acknowledged without letting it define everything.
short_reversed_meaning: Healing may involve revisiting pain with greater compassion.

name: 4 of Swords
short_upright_meaning: Rest can be part of the work when the mind needs time to recover.
short_reversed_meaning: Notice whether stillness is restoring energy or becoming another source of worry.

name: 5 of Swords
short_upright_meaning: Winning an argument may cost more than the victory was worth.
short_reversed_meaning: Choose whether to repair a conflict or release a contest that benefits nobody.

name: 6 of Swords
short_upright_meaning: A gradual move away from strain may need patience and support.
short_reversed_meaning: Leaving a hard chapter can take longer than deciding to go.

name: 7 of Swords
short_upright_meaning: Use discretion thoughtfully while checking the cost of avoiding open discussion.
short_reversed_meaning: A hidden strategy may need honesty with yourself before it can change.

name: 8 of Swords
short_upright_meaning: Some constraints are real and others need testing; distinguish them carefully.
short_reversed_meaning: A modest change in perspective can reveal a choice that felt unavailable.

name: 9 of Swords
short_upright_meaning: Strong worries can feel like facts; seek a steadier view of what is known.
short_reversed_meaning: Support and perspective may help loosen a cycle of private anxiety.

name: 10 of Swords
short_upright_meaning: An exhausting chapter may be reaching an endpoint; its meaning is symbolic, not literal harm.
short_reversed_meaning: Recovery is possible after a hard ending, even if rebuilding takes time.

name: Page of Swords
short_upright_meaning: Questioning and observation can sharpen an emerging understanding.
short_reversed_meaning: Avoid letting quick suspicion outrun careful fact-checking.

name: Knight of Swords
short_upright_meaning: Move with conviction while leaving room for new information.
short_reversed_meaning: A sharp mind may need to slow before its words cause damage.

name: Queen of Swords
short_upright_meaning: Clear language and boundaries can coexist with compassion.
short_reversed_meaning: Let discernment protect you without turning every encounter into judgment.

name: King of Swords
short_upright_meaning: Sound decisions benefit from reason that answers to humane values.
short_reversed_meaning: Check whether a strong argument has lost sight of the people involved.

name: Ace of Pentacles
short_upright_meaning: A small, concrete opportunity can become a lasting resource through care.
short_reversed_meaning: Revisit the practical foundation before committing more resources.

name: 2 of Pentacles
short_upright_meaning: Handling several moving parts requires rhythm and deliberate tradeoffs.
short_reversed_meaning: A crowded schedule may be asking for one fewer ball in the air.

name: 3 of Pentacles
short_upright_meaning: Distinct skills become more useful when people build toward a common standard.
short_reversed_meaning: Improve the way expertise is shared before judging the work alone.

name: 4 of Pentacles
short_upright_meaning: Protect what matters while remembering that resources are meant to serve life.
short_reversed_meaning: A tight grip can keep security from becoming useful freedom.

name: 5 of Pentacles
short_upright_meaning: Difficulty need not be faced in isolation; noticing support is a practical strength.
short_reversed_meaning: Recovery may begin by accepting a hand that was previously hard to see.

name: 6 of Pentacles
short_upright_meaning: Giving and receiving work best when dignity flows both ways.
short_reversed_meaning: Examine whether a supposed gift creates a hidden obligation.

name: 7 of Pentacles
short_upright_meaning: Pause to measure what sustained work has actually produced.
short_reversed_meaning: Redirect energy when the evidence no longer supports the original plan.

name: 8 of Pentacles
short_upright_meaning: Deliberate practice turns repeated effort into real skill.
short_reversed_meaning: Check whether polishing details has replaced progress on the real goal.

name: 9 of Pentacles
short_upright_meaning: Enjoy the independence and comfort your sustained effort has made possible.
short_reversed_meaning: Consider whether achievement feels secure when approval or resources change.

name: 10 of Pentacles
short_upright_meaning: The value of a legacy lies in what it enables future people to sustain.
short_reversed_meaning: Reconsider inherited expectations when they undermine lasting wellbeing.

name: Page of Pentacles
short_upright_meaning: A beginner's willingness to learn can turn an idea into a concrete skill.
short_reversed_meaning: Give the promising idea a realistic first task rather than endless planning.

name: Knight of Pentacles
short_upright_meaning: Steady effort builds trust when progress is measured honestly.
short_reversed_meaning: Revisit the routine if careful repetition has stopped serving the goal.

name: Queen of Pentacles
short_upright_meaning: Practical generosity makes daily life more stable and welcoming.
short_reversed_meaning: Sustain your own resources before becoming everyone's foundation.

name: King of Pentacles
short_upright_meaning: Responsible stewardship turns resources into reliable support for others.
short_reversed_meaning: Measure success by the good resources make possible, not by accumulation alone.
